( 16 augustus 2024 , Erik Schüssel )

So the job consists of calculation, design engineering (mostly mechanical), work preparation and even a bit of project coordination. 
Requirements: - Engineering degree - Knowledge of horticultural installations is a nice to have - Proficiency in AutoCAD - Strong command of the English language - Structured and a team player 
At this company, they strive to develop customized horticultural solutions that minimize the ecological footprint. Join their team and contribute to a better future in the agricultural sector! 
They have a good salary package on offer (basic: 40.000 - 60.000 euro/year), including 32 vacation days, bonus potential, a nice diverse team and best of all: the possibility to work on challenging and international projects with a focus on food security and sustainability.
